title_or_caption: Our comunidad needs support — now more than ever
source_summary: CLUES shares its new President & CEO's message about listening to families, responding to urgent needs, providing emergency assistance and culturally responsive care, and supporting the CLUES Emergency Relief Fund during uncertain times.

title_or_caption: Opportunity Crossing community investment and partnership
source_summary: PPL thanks the Minneapolis Foundation and fundholders for investment in Opportunity Crossing, a mixed-use affordable housing development that will house more than 100 families and local businesses.
PPL celebrates COO Scott Cordes for leadership and advocacy in affordable housing and community impact across the Twin Cities.

title_or_caption: Supporting CAP schools and flexible education
source_summary: PPL uses a student story from MERC Alternative School to advocate for Minnesota Contract Alternative Program schools, describing flexibility and individualized support during a period when families were affected by increased ICE activity, alongside other barriers such as housing instability, health challenges, and language gaps.

title_or_caption: Power Shift 25 recognition and Minnesota community reflection
source_summary: PPL celebrates President and CEO Karla Henderson's Power Shift 25 recognition while reflecting on difficult recent months for Minnesota communities and emphasizing staff resolve, partnerships, housing access, and economic opportunity.
HAP promotes three virtual spring workshops for small-business owners covering access to capital, cash-flow management, and digital marketing.
